# Cover › Geometric

**What belongs here.** The cover is built from clean shapes.

**Examples.** shape burst, grid of circles or squares, hexagon fill

**Family test.** Pause at the middle: is the frame mostly or entirely a layer that is neither A nor B?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Shape Burst](shape-burst/) | Rings of colour burst out from a point one after another until the last one covers the frame, then a hole bursts open the same way. |
| [Shape Grid](shape-grid/) | A grid of shapes scales up in a wave until they cover the frame, then shrinks away in the same direction to show the next scene. |
